\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{مزیت} (maziyat)}{مزیت (maziyat)}]{\fa{مزیت} (maziyat) — an advantage, a merit}

\label{lesson:FA-C375-maziyyat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to make progress, then the Persian for to fall behind.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{مزیت}}
\textbf{\fa{مزیت}} (\emph{maziyat}) — \textquotedblleft{}an advantage, a merit\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{مزیت} \fa{این} \fa{کار} \fa{این} \fa{است} \fa{که} \fa{نزدیک} \fa{خانه} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{maziyat-e in kâr in ast ke nazdik-e khâne ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The advantage of this job is that it is near home.
\end{quote}

Its Arabic broken plural \emph{mazâyâ} also means benefits at work.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{مزیت}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{maziyya} \textquotedblleft{}merit, distinction\textquotedblright{}, the quality that sets one thing above another.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{maziyat}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{maziyat}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{maziyat}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to make progress, then the Persian for to fall behind, then say \emph{maziyat} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{مزیت} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An advantage, a merit\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{عیب} ('eyb)}{عیب ('eyb)}]{\fa{عیب} ('eyb) — a flaw, a defect}

\label{lesson:FA-C375-eyb}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to fall behind, then the Persian for an advantage.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{عیب}}
\textbf{\fa{عیب}} (\emph{'eyb}) — \textquotedblleft{}a flaw, a defect\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{تنها} \fa{عیب} \fa{این} \fa{ماشین} \fa{رنگ} \fa{آن} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{tanhâ 'eyb-e in mâshin rang-e ân ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The only flaw of this car is its colour.
\end{quote}

\emph{'Eyb nadârad} — never mind, it doesn't matter. Plural \emph{'oyub}, an Arabic broken plural.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{عیب}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{'ayb} \textquotedblleft{}fault, blemish\textquotedblright{}; in Persian it is a flaw in a thing or in a person.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{زیان} (ziyân)}{زیان (ziyân)}]{\fa{زیان} (ziyân) — harm, a loss}

\label{lesson:FA-C375-ziyan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for an advantage, then the Persian for a flaw.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{زیان}}
\textbf{\fa{زیان}} (\emph{ziyân}) — \textquotedblleft{}harm, a loss\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{سیگار} \fa{برای} \fa{بدن} \fa{زیان} \fa{دارد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{sigâr barâye badan ziyân dârad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Smoking is harmful to the body.
\end{quote}

\emph{Ziyân dâshtan} — to be harmful; \emph{ziyân didan} — to suffer a loss.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{زیان}} \textquotedblleft{}damage, injury\textquotedblright{} is listed in EtymDB without a parent; it is an inherited Persian word, usually traced to Middle Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{ارزش} \fa{داشتن} (arzesh dâshtan)}{ارزش داشتن (arzesh dâshtan)}]{\fa{ارزش} \fa{داشتن} (arzesh dâshtan) — to be worth it, to be worth}

\label{lesson:FA-C375-arzesh-dashtan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a flaw, then the Persian for harm.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{ارزش} \fa{داشتن}}
\textbf{\fa{ارزش} \fa{داشتن}} (\emph{arzesh dâshtan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to be worth it, to be worth\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{این} \fa{فیلم} \fa{ارزش} \fa{دیدن} \fa{دارد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{in film arzesh-e didan dârad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This film is worth seeing.
\end{quote}

\emph{Arzesh} \textquotedblleft{}value\textquotedblright{} + \emph{dâshtan} (stem \emph{dâr-}), with an ezafe: \emph{arzesh-e … dârad}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{ارزش} \fa{داشتن}} is native Persian, built from \emph{arzesh} \textquotedblleft{}value\textquotedblright{}, itself built on \emph{arz-}, the present stem of \emph{arzidan} \textquotedblleft{}to be worth\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{dâshtan} \textquotedblleft{}to have\textquotedblright{}, the inherited verb.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a flaw, then the Persian for harm, then say \emph{arzesh dâshtan} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{نتیجه} \fa{دادن} (natije dâdan)}{نتیجه دادن (natije dâdan)}]{\fa{نتیجه} \fa{دادن} (natije dâdan) — to pay off, to work}

\label{lesson:FA-C375-natije-dadan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for harm, then the Persian for to be worth it.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{نتیجه} \fa{دادن}}
\textbf{\fa{نتیجه} \fa{دادن}} (\emph{natije dâdan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to pay off, to work\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{تلاش} \fa{او} \fa{بالاخره} \fa{نتیجه} \fa{داد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{talâsh-e u bâlâkhare natije dâd.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Her effort finally paid off.
\end{quote}

\emph{Natije} \textquotedblleft{}result\textquotedblright{} + \emph{dâdan} \textquotedblleft{}to give\textquotedblright{} (stem \emph{deh-}): literally to give a result.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{نتیجه} \fa{دادن}} is literally \textquotedblleft{}to give a result\textquotedblright{}: \emph{natije} comes from Arabic \emph{natīja} \textquotedblleft{}result\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB), and \emph{dâdan} \textquotedblleft{}to give\textquotedblright{} is traced by EtymDB to PIE \emph{deh\textsubscript{3}-}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 368–375 — a review}

\label{lesson:FA-R375-review-368-375}



\begin{quote}
Say the Persian for an analysis and to analyse.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an analysis, to analyse, an impression, a conclusion, to mention
  \item a cause, a factor, to cause, to bring about, owing to
  \item a consequence, repercussions, as a result, to lead to, to conclude
  \item because of, for this reason, hence, therefore, considering
  \item an influence, to influence, to stem from, to give rise to, a reaction
  \item an increase, to increase, a decrease, to reduce, to grow
  \item an improvement, to improve, progress, to make progress, to fall behind
  \item an advantage, a flaw, harm, to be worth it, to pay off
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An analysis? (\textbf{\fa{تحلیل}}.) To analyse? (\textbf{\fa{تحلیل} \fa{کردن}}.) An impression? (\textbf{\fa{برداشت}}.) A conclusion? (\textbf{\fa{نتیجه} \fa{گیری}}.) To mention? (\textbf{\fa{اشاره} \fa{کردن}}.) A cause? (\textbf{\fa{علت}}.) A factor? (\textbf{\fa{عامل}}.) To cause? (\textbf{\fa{باعث} \fa{شدن}}.) To bring about? (\textbf{\fa{سبب} \fa{شدن}}.) Owing to? (\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{علت}}.) A consequence? (\textbf{\fa{پیامد}}.) Repercussions? (\textbf{\fa{عواقب}}.) As a result? (\textbf{\fa{در} \fa{نتیجه}}.) To lead to? (\textbf{\fa{منجر} \fa{شدن}}.) To conclude? (\textbf{\fa{نتیجه} \fa{گرفتن}}.) Because of? (\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{دلیل}}.) For this reason? (\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{همین} \fa{دلیل}}.) Hence? (\textbf{\fa{از} \fa{این} \fa{رو}}.) Therefore? (\textbf{\fa{لذا}}.) Considering? (\textbf{\fa{با} \fa{توجه} \fa{به}}.) An influence? (\textbf{\fa{تاثیر}}.) To influence? (\textbf{\fa{تاثیر} \fa{گذاشتن}}.) To stem from? (\textbf{\fa{ناشی} \fa{شدن}}.) To give rise to? (\textbf{\fa{موجب} \fa{شدن}}.) A reaction? (\textbf{\fa{واکنش}}.) An increase? (\textbf{\fa{افزایش}}.) To increase? (\textbf{\fa{افزایش} \fa{یافتن}}.) A decrease? (\textbf{\fa{کاهش}}.) To reduce? (\textbf{\fa{کاهش} \fa{دادن}}.) To grow? (\textbf{\fa{رشد} \fa{کردن}}.) An improvement? (\textbf{\fa{بهبود}}.) To improve? (\textbf{\fa{بهبود} \fa{یافتن}}.) Progress? (\textbf{\fa{پیشرفت}}.) To make progress? (\textbf{\fa{پیشرفت} \fa{کردن}}.) To fall behind? (\textbf{\fa{عقب} \fa{ماندن}}.) An advantage? (\textbf{\fa{مزیت}}.) A flaw? (\textbf{\fa{عیب}}.) Harm? (\textbf{\fa{زیان}}.) To be worth it? (\textbf{\fa{ارزش} \fa{داشتن}}.) To pay off? (\textbf{\fa{نتیجه} \fa{دادن}}.)
